thread:
Helen: Hey infra — planning to launch the "orca-dedicated" cluster in AWS us-west-3 next month. Need help with GPU quota (A100), ENI/IP limits, NAT design, and PrivateLink/VPC endpoint guidance. Can someone assist with quota requests + review the VPC plan?

Raj: Which AWS account (prod/dev)? timeline? expected instance counts and AZ spread? Also are you trying to reserve capacity or burstable?

Helen: Account: 123456789012 (prod). Timeline: staging in 3 weeks, prod in 6 weeks. Initial steady capacity: 40 A100-backed instances, expected burst/cold-start peaks up to ~120. 3 AZs in us-west-3. Prefer one VPC with isolated private subnets per cluster.

Dave: Heads up — us-west-3 has limited on-demand A100 inventory right now. We'll need to request both service quota increases and capacity reservations/host offers with AWS. If we want guaranteed density, consider requesting placement/EC2 capacity reservation or fallback to A10G types for overflow. Also need exact subnet plan (CIDR) and NAT/egress architecture.

Helen: Subnet plan draft: 3 AZs, each with a private worker subnet /20 (about 4k IPs) and a control subnet /26. Public subnets for ALB/SSH jumpboxes /27 per AZ. Plan: one NAT gateway per AZ for HA (3 NAT GWs). Central shared-services VPC will hold TGW + centralized egress for infra teams.

Ong: Quick notes: NAT Gateway = 1 EIP each, default EIP quota is 5 per region — we'll need to raise that. Also ENI/IP limits matter: instance ENI limits depend on instance size, but aggregated ENI/IP counts across many nodes can hit the account-level elastic network interfaces or prefix limits. Request increases for "Elastic IPs", "VPCs per Region" (if creating more than default), and "Network Interfaces per Region".

Raj: Can you paste the exact numbers we should request? I'll open AWS Service Quotas tickets. Template: 
```
Account ID: 123456789012
Region: us-west-3
Quota changes requested: 
- Running On-Demand p4d instances: current X -> 120
- Running On-Demand p4de instances: current Y -> 40 (fallback)
- Elastic IPs: current 5 -> 30
- NAT Gateways per Region: current 5 -> 10
- Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) per Region: current 500 -> 5000
- VPCs per Region: current 5 -> 20
- Prefix list size / managed prefix lists: increase to support PrivateLink rules

Reason: Dedicated inference fleet for 'orca-dedicated' with steady 40 A100 nodes and burst to 120. 3 AZs, central TGW egress, PrivateLink for control-plane services.
```

Helen: Drafted support ticket body below — feel free to adjust before you submit: 
```
Hello AWS Support,

We're Redwood Inference (Account 123456789012). Requesting quota increases in us-west-3 to support a new dedicated inference fleet (orca-dedicated).
- Request increase for Running On-Demand p4d instances to 120.
- Request Running On-Demand p4de instances to 40 as fallback.
- Increase Elastic IP quota to 30 (we plan 3 NAT GWs + 10 EIPs for shared services and LB needs).
- Increase NAT Gateway quota to 10 to support additional projects/DR.
- Increase Elastic Network Interfaces per Region to 5000.
- Increase VPCs per Region to 20.
- Request managed prefix list size increase to allow 3000 entries for PrivateLink routing and service CIDR controls.

Timeline: staging in ~3 weeks, production in 6 weeks. Please advise on estimated lead times and if any capacity reservations or placement group actions are required to guarantee A100 availability.

Thanks,
Helen (Infra/Product)
```

infra-bot: Created support case #9876543210 with AWS WAF/Support — awaiting AWS response. (automated)

Sara: Security note — S3 should use a gateway endpoint (no interface endpoint) to avoid cost. For control-plane services (Secrets Manager, ECR, Systems Manager) we need VPC endpoints (interface) + KMS route to our key in the customer master account. Also confirm whether traffic from dedicated cluster to our KMS HSM needs cross-account peering or PrivateLink.

Will: Cost FYI — NAT Gateway pricing and EIP fees can add up with 3 NATs across multiple accounts. If we centralize egress via shared-services + TGW we can reduce NAT count and save ~30-40% egress infra cost, but that increases cross-account bandwidth. Need monthly outbound TB estimate to model.

Helen: Expected outbound: ~120 TB/month steady, peaks ~300 TB. We can try central egress for cost but must ensure bandwidth and SLOs. Also need S3 PUT/GET patterns for cost estimates (mostly GETs).

Dave: I'll prepare a consolidated quota request and an infra PR for the VPC/TGW design with explicit route tables and prefix lists. Also looping in cloud-ops to check regional A100 procurement options.

Helen: Thanks — please tag me on the support case when submitted.

infra-bot: AWS replied (automated): "We've received the request. For GPU capacity increases in us-west-3, partner capacity checks required. Please provide target AZs and whether you need dedicated capacity reservations."

Raj: I submitted the Service Quotas change for the numbers above and included requested AZs. Case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=9876543210

Will: I'll run a quick cost spreadsheet for central egress vs per-VPC NAT and share numbers by EOD.

Helen: Great — appreciate the quick turn. Will monitor the support case and post any AWS followups here. :tada:
